verses.1: Bezalel made the ark of acacia wood, two and a half cubits long, one and a half cubits wide, and one and a half cubits high.
verses.2: He overlaid it with pure gold, inside and out, and made a gold molding all around it.
verses.3: He cast four gold rings for it on its four corners, two rings on its one side and two rings on its second side.
verses.4: He made poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.
verses.5: He inserted the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark to carry the ark.
verses.6: He made a lid of pure gold, two and a half cubits long and one and a half cubits wide.
verses.7: He made two cherubim of hammered gold, making them from the two ends of the lid.
verses.8: One cherub from the one end and one cherub from the second end, making the cherubim from the two ends of the lid.
verses.9: The cherubim had their wings spread upward, overshadowing the lid with their wings, and their faces turned to each other, facing the lid the cherubim were facing.
verses.10: Bezalel made the table of acacia wood, two cubits long, one cubit wide, and one and a half cubits high.
verses.11: He overlaid it with pure gold and made a gold molding all around it.
verses.12: He made a rim an handbreadth around it and made a gold molding for its rim all around.
verses.13: He cast four gold rings and placed the rings on the four corners at the base of its four legs.
verses.14: The rings were opposite the rim as holders for the poles to carry the table.
verses.15: He made the poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold to carry the table.
verses.16: He made the vessels on the table, its bowls, its ladles, its jars, and its incense ladles, all of pure gold.
verses.17: He made the lampstand of pure gold, hammered from one piece: its base, its shaft, its cups, its calyxes, and its flowers were all from it.
verses.18: Six branches came from its sides, three branches from its one side and three branches from its second side.
verses.19: Three cups, each with a calyx and a flower, on each one branch; three cups, each with a calyx and a flower, on each one branch. The same for the six branches coming from the lampstand.
verses.20: On the lampstand itself were four cups, each with a calyx and a flower.
verses.21: A calyx under the two branches from it, a calyx under the two branches from it, a calyx under the two branches from it for the six branches coming from it.
verses.22: Their calyxes and their branches were all of it, one piece of hammered pure gold.
verses.23: He made its seven lamps and their snuffers and their trays, all of pure gold.
verses.24: He made it with a talent of pure gold, and all its vessels.
verses.25: He made the incense altar of acacia wood, one cubit long, one cubit wide, square, and two cubits high. Its horns were of it.
verses.26: He overlaid it with pure gold, its top, its surrounding walls, and its horns, and made a gold molding all around it.
verses.27: He made two gold rings for it beneath its molding, on its two sides, as holders for the poles to carry it.
verses.28: He made the poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.
verses.29: He made the anointing oil, sacred oil, and the incense, pure beaten work.

notes:
Notes
- v. 1: "Bezalel" is the proper name for the artisan mentioned in Exodus 31:2 and 35:30–35.
- v. 25: "incense altar" refers to the smaller altar used specifically for burning incense, distinct from the bronze altar of burnt offering.
- v. 29: The anointing oil and incense are to be treated as sacred substances, their composition specified in Exodus 30.
